# Mountain Race Shop

> Motorcycle handling diagnosis and suspension engineering workshop serving Canberra, ACT, Snowy Monaro, Bombala, Delegate, Bega Valley and surrounding NSW regions, with mountain bike suspension servicing for Snowy Mountains riders.

Mountain Race Shop diagnoses motorcycle handling problems before recommending suspension work. Motorcycle services include fork servicing, shock servicing, spring-rate and sag setup, suspension revalving, steering-head bearing service, brake pad inspection/replacement, race support and engineering analysis. Mountain bike services include selected fork and shock servicing, lower-leg and air-can maintenance, full services and setup/diagnosis subject to model and parts availability. The workshop is at 2572 Shannons Flat Rd, Shannons Flat NSW 2620, Australia. Phone: +61 420 947 505. Email: craig@mountainraceshop.com.au.

## Motorcycle workshop pricing
- Fork service off bike: A$320
- Shock service off bike: A$340
- Fork + shock service off bike together: A$600
- Fork service complete bike: A$360
- Shock service complete bike: A$460
- Revalve + springs + service, fork and shock off bike: A$1,260
- Revalve + springs + service, complete bike: A$1,470
- Air-fork revalve + service off bike: A$1,080
- Air-fork revalve + shock service off bike: A$1,260
- Suspension Setup Saturday: A$50, credited toward recommended suspension work booked within 30 days
- Steering-head bearing check/adjustment with other workshop work: A$60
- Steering-head bearing clean/regrease: from A$160
- Steering-head bearing replacement: from A$320 including a standard bearing kit; model-specific costs quoted first
- Brake pad inspection: included with suspension service
- Brake pad replacement: A$45 labour per caliper plus pads; pad price confirmed before fitting
- Tyre fitting: A$30 per tyre plus tube if required

Standard motorcycle suspension prices assume normal serviceable components. Extra wear parts, damage, coatings, shafts, tubes and unexpected repairs are confirmed before work begins.

## MTB suspension pricing
- Lower-leg / air-can service: from A$130
- Full fork service: from A$299
- Full rear shock service: from A$249
- Fork + shock full service: from A$520
- Complete-bike removal/refit and setup/diagnosis: quoted after confirming the exact bike and suspension model

MTB prices are starting prices. Final price depends on the exact fork or shock, service kit, parts availability and condition, with additional costs confirmed before work begins.

## Positioning
Mountain Race Shop uses an engineering-backed diagnostic approach: rider complaint, bike, rider weight, terrain and use are considered before recommending springs, servicing, revalving or setup changes. The business is positioned around diagnosis and technical understanding rather than generic motorcycle repair or price competition.

## Geographic service areas
Canberra and ACT; Shannons Flat; Cooma and Snowy Monaro; Jindabyne and Thredbo; Bombala and Delegate; Bega Valley and the NSW South Coast.
